title: All Divisions With the Highest Score of a Binary Array
summary: Given a binary array nums, find all indices where dividing the array into two parts results in the highest division score.
statement: Given a binary array nums, find all indices where dividing the array into two parts results in the highest division score. The score is the count of 0's in the left part plus the count of 1's in the right part. Return these indices in any order.
constraints: For split i from zero through n, the left side is nums[:i] and right side nums[i:].
Score equals left zeros plus right ones.
Return every maximum-score split index in any order.
hints: Update the split score incrementally as one element crosses from right to left.
Start with all right-side ones; moving zero adds one, moving one subtracts one.
Track the best score and replace or append its split index after each move.
Each update exactly reflects the score definition for the next split, including empty-side splits zero and n.
editorial: Each update exactly reflects the score definition for the next split, including empty-side splits zero and n.

tests.explanation: Splits two and four both score three, the maximum.
Only split three places all zeros on the left, so it is uniquely best.
